control_question: Are the tenants, systems, privileged roles, integrations, endpoints, and review period in scope documented?
required_evidence: Approved review scope and system inventory
validation_method: Compare the approved scope with active tenants, roles, integrations, and managed endpoints

control_question: Is there a current catalog of security-relevant and operational audit events?
required_evidence: Dated audit-event catalog with event names and fields
validation_method: Map representative console, API, agent, policy, job, and remote-session actions to emitted events

control_question: Does every privileged event identify the human, service account, or integration that initiated it?
required_evidence: Sample events for technicians, support users, service accounts, and API clients
validation_method: Perform approved test actions under distinct identities and compare the recorded actor fields

control_question: Does every event preserve the customer or tenant boundary where the action occurred?
required_evidence: Tenant-scoped sample events and isolation design
validation_method: Run equivalent approved actions in two test tenants and verify unambiguous tenant attribution

control_question: Do endpoint actions preserve durable device identity rather than display name alone?
required_evidence: Sample events containing endpoint ID and current display name
validation_method: Rename a test endpoint and verify historical events remain attributable to the same durable identity

control_question: Do events record the action type and bounded parameters needed to understand what changed?
required_evidence: Event samples for policy, script, patch, alert, user, token, and configuration changes
validation_method: Reconstruct approved test changes without relying on technician memory

control_question: Do events record queued, accepted, completed, failed, timed-out, cancelled, and denied outcomes where applicable?
required_evidence: Lifecycle event samples for successful and unsuccessful work
validation_method: Execute harmless success, denial, failure, and cancellation cases in a test scope

control_question: Are event timestamps authoritative, timezone-explicit, and consistent across console, API, and endpoint records?
required_evidence: Timestamp specification and synchronized sample events
validation_method: Compare a test action across browser, API, server, and endpoint evidence using UTC

control_question: Are remote sessions attributable by actor, tenant, endpoint, start, end, authorization mode, and outcome?
required_evidence: Attended and unattended remote-session audit samples
validation_method: Run approved test sessions and reconcile authorization, connection, termination, and duration

control_question: Are script creation, revision, approval, targeting, execution, output disposition, and result logged?
required_evidence: Script and automation lifecycle samples
validation_method: Trace one harmless script from immutable revision through target selection and terminal result

control_question: Are patch policy changes, approvals, deployment targets, exceptions, reboots, and outcomes auditable?
required_evidence: Patch policy and deployment event samples
validation_method: Trace one test update from approval through endpoint reconciliation

control_question: Are alert creation, acknowledgement, assignment, suppression, reopening, and closure retained?
required_evidence: Alert lifecycle samples and suppression history
validation_method: Exercise an approved test alert through each supported state and verify retained history

control_question: Are user, role, permission, MFA, session, and access-review changes logged?
required_evidence: Administrative identity event samples
validation_method: Create and revoke a least-privilege test role and verify complete attribution

control_question: Are token creation, scope change, rotation, revocation, webhook change, and integration failure logged without exposing secrets?
required_evidence: Credential lifecycle and integration event samples
validation_method: Rotate a test credential and confirm metadata is present while secret material is absent

control_question: Are policy, threshold, maintenance-window, notification, retention, and tenant-setting changes captured before and after?
required_evidence: Configuration change event samples
validation_method: Change and restore an approved test setting and compare the recorded old and new values

control_question: Are authorization failures and cross-tenant or out-of-scope attempts logged with safe diagnostic detail?
required_evidence: Denied-action event samples and alerting rules
validation_method: Attempt approved negative tests and verify the denial is attributable without leaking sensitive data

control_question: Can ordinary administrators alter or delete audit records, and are stronger integrity controls documented?
required_evidence: Write-path design, permission model, and integrity evidence
validation_method: Attempt permitted negative tests for edit and delete operations under ordinary administrator roles

control_question: Is retention long enough for contracts, investigations, regulatory needs, and delayed detection?
required_evidence: Retention policy and configured values by tenant or service
validation_method: Compare configured retention with obligations and oldest available test records

control_question: Can authorized reviewers export complete events with stable identifiers, schema, timezone, and filters?
required_evidence: Sample export and export procedure
validation_method: Export a bounded review period and reconcile counts and identifiers with the source view

control_question: Do filters, pagination, sorting, and time boundaries return complete non-duplicated results?
required_evidence: Search behavior specification and test results
validation_method: Query a known event set across page boundaries and compare totals, order, and duplicates

control_question: Are high-risk events routed to an owner or SIEM with delivery failure detection?
required_evidence: Detection rules, routing map, and delivery health evidence
validation_method: Trigger approved high-risk test events and verify receipt, ownership, and failure alerting

control_question: Is there a named owner, review frequency, risk-based sample, and documented disposition process?
required_evidence: Approved audit-review procedure and recent completed review
validation_method: Inspect the latest review for scope, sampling, findings, assigned work, and closure evidence

control_question: Can an investigator correlate audit events with jobs, alerts, notifications, endpoint telemetry, and support records?
required_evidence: Cross-system identifiers and investigation worksheet
validation_method: Reconstruct one approved scenario across systems using retained correlation identifiers

control_question: Are missing events, schema gaps, delivery failures, and retention exceptions owned, time-bounded, retested, and closed?
required_evidence: Exception register and remediation evidence
validation_method: Sample open and closed audit gaps for owner, due date, approval, compensating control, and retest
